title: Why Does the Sun Rise in the East?
narration: This 3D Short is only about this: Why Does the Sun Rise in the East.
So the sun appears to climb from that side.
Let me show you that in 3D.
It is Earth moving, not the sun racing around us.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
Sunset is the same spin, other side.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Earth spins toward the east.
The pictures today are a new sun world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why does the sun rise in the east.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
